question: Will Naftali Bennett be the next prime minister sworn in after the 2026 Knesset election?
resolution_criteria: Yes if Naftali Bennett is the next individual formally sworn in as Prime Minister of Israel following the 2026 election, by December 31, 2027. Interim or caretaker prime ministers do not count.

history.rationale: 10/27/2026 update to the market price 8.5%. No independent news view.
11/07/2026: the crowd's price 1.7%, used as is: the question has no fixed close date (it resolves when a prime minister is sworn in), so no horizon map applies. No independent news view.
